**In one line**: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is reported to have offered an optimistic forecast that AI could cure most human diseases within the next 5 to 10 years.

### Key points
- According to Indian outlet India Today, Amodei suggested AI could accelerate biomedical research — drug discovery, diagnostics — enough to conquer most diseases within 5-10 years.
- The remark echoes his earlier essay "Machines of Loving Grace," which argued AI could dramatically compress the timeline of scientific discovery.
- Skeptics continue to question the specific timing, alongside the regulatory and clinical validation hurdles such breakthroughs would face.

### Why it matters
Forecasts from a leading AI lab's CEO shape investment and expectations across healthcare and biotech. The real signal lies in reading the gap between headline optimism and the practical constraints of medical science.
